'''Comfrey''' is a small village north of [[Baerlon]], in [[Andor]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Comfrey}}

When [[Matrim Cauthon]] delivers [[Elayne Trakand]]'s letter to [[Morgase Trakand]], he does so under the alias of "Thom Grinwell," claiming to be from Comfrey.{{ref/book|3|46}}
